$comment: Generated automatically from Doco-CD's Go configuration types. Do not edit manually.
description: One deployment configuration per YAML document. Fields may be omitted in auto-discovery overrides; required fields and deployment-dependent rules are checked by doco-cd at runtime.

name.description: Name of the docker-compose deployment / stack

source.description: Source selects the deployment source backend (git or oci)

version.description: Version declares the deployment config schema/artifact version for OCI-backed deployments

repository_url.description: RepositoryUrl is the Git clone URL of the repository to deploy

webhook_filter.description: WebhookEventFilter is a regular expression to whitelist deployment triggers based on the webhook event payload (e.g., branch like "^refs/heads/main$" or "main", tag like "^refs/tags/v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$" or "v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+")

reference.description: Reference is the Git reference to the deployment, e.g., refs/heads/main, main, refs/tags/v1.0.0 or v1.0.0

working_dir.description: WorkingDirectory is the working directory for the deployment

context.description: Context is the Docker context to use for this deployment (empty uses the default Docker context)

compose_files.description: ComposeFiles is the list of docker-compose files to use

environment.description: Environment is a map of environment variables to use for variable interpolation in the compose files

env_files.description: EnvFiles is the list of dotenv files to use for variable interpolation

remove_orphans.description: RemoveOrphans removes containers for services not defined in the Compose file

prune_images.description: PruneImages removes images that are no longer used by any service

enabled.description: Enabled explicitly selects Swarm deployment mode. When unset, the Docker context determines the mode.

config_retention.description: ConfigRetention is the number of old Swarm config revisions to keep per resource (excluding the active one). -1 disables automatic pruning. If unset, global DOCKER_SWARM_CONFIG_RETENTION is used.

secret_retention.description: SecretRetention is the number of old Swarm secret revisions to keep per resource (excluding the active one). -1 disables automatic pruning. If unset, global DOCKER_SWARM_SECRET_RETENTION is used.

swarm.description: Swarm contains Docker Swarm-specific deployment settings

wait_running_jobs.description: WaitRunningJobs waits for currently running scheduled job containers/services to finish before deployment

force_recreate.description: ForceRecreate forces the recreation/redeployment of containers even if the configuration has not changed

force_image_pull.description: ForceImagePull always pulls the latest version of the image tags you've specified if a newer version is available

timeout.description: Timeout is the maximum time to wait for deployment; numeric values are seconds and strings accept Go duration syntax.

args.description: BuildArgs is a map of build-time arguments to pass to the build process

force_image_pull.description: ForceImagePull always attempt to pull a newer version of the image

no_cache.description: NoCache disables the use of the cache when building images

build.description: BuildOpts is the build options for the deployment

git_depth.description: GitDepth limits the number of commits to fetch. 0 means use global GIT_CLONE_DEPTH. A positive value overrides the global setting.

enabled.description: Enabled removes the deployment and all its resources from the Docker host

remove_volumes.description: RemoveVolumes removes the volumes used by the deployment (always enabled in docker swarm mode)

remove_images.description: RemoveImages removes the images used by the deployment (currently not supported in docker swarm mode)

remove_dir.description: Deprecated: RemoveRepoDir is ignored because the source directory is shared by all stacks of a repository

destroy.description: Destroy configures destruction of the deployment and related resources

profiles.description: Profiles is a list of profiles to use for the deployment, e.g., ["dev", "prod"]. See https://docs.docker.com/compose/how-tos/profiles/

external_secrets.description: ExternalSecrets maps env vars to legacy string references or structured references (e.g. webhook store_ref/remote_ref).

store_ref.description:
StoreRef is the name of the global webhook secret store to use, as defined
in the store YAML file (e.g. `store_ref: bitwarden-login`).
Used exclusively by the webhook provider.

remote_ref.description:
RemoteRef contains the dynamic key/value pairs that are substituted into
the store's URL, headers, body and json_path templates at resolution time
(e.g. `key`, `property`, or any custom field the store templates reference).
Used exclusively by the webhook provider.

external_secrets_files.description: ExternalSecretsFiles is a list of YAML files, each holding a map of env var name to external secret reference (same shape as ExternalSecrets). Files are merged first, then ExternalSecrets entries are applied on top (inline wins on key collision).

depth.description: ScanDepth is the maximum depth of subdirectories to scan for docker-compose files

enabled.description: Enabled enables autodiscovery of services to deploy in the working directory

delete.description: Delete removes obsolete auto-discovered deployments that are no longer present in the repository

remove_volumes.description: RemoveVolumes removes the volumes of an auto-discovered deployment when it is deleted

remove_images.description: RemoveImages removes the images of an auto-discovered deployment when it is deleted

auto_discovery.description: AutoDiscovery configures autodiscovery of services to deploy in the working directory

events.description: Events is the list of Docker container actions that trigger reconciliation

restart_timeout.description: RestartTimeout is the timeout to wait before killing a container during a restart.

restart_signal.description: RestartSignal is the signal sent to stop containers during a restart. If not set, the default of the Docker daemon is used (SIGTERM).

restart_limit.description: RestartLimit suppresses further unhealthy-triggered restarts after this many restarts in the configured window. Set to 0 to disable suppression.

restart_window.description: RestartWindow is the time window used with RestartLimit.

reconciliation.description: Reconciliation is the configuration for the reconciliation feature

verify.description: Verify enables OCI signature verification; it cannot disable verification enabled globally.

issuer.description: Issuer is the trusted OIDC issuer for a keyless signature.

subject.description: Subject is the exact trusted identity for a keyless signature.

subject_regexp.description: SubjectRegexp matches trusted keyless identities with a regular expression.

keyless_identities.description: KeylessIdentities overrides the trusted identities for keyless OCI signatures.

public_keys.description: PublicKeys overrides the public keys used to verify OCI signatures.

ignore_tlog.description: IgnoreTlog controls whether transparency log verification is skipped.

oci.description: Oci allows per-target overrides for OCI signature verification policy

title: Doco-CD deployment configuration
